text_block_list.text:
On the day of our outing with Rhein Kraft, 
I asked her where she wanted to go next, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about something like 
"Fluffy-Wuffy"?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The petting zoo area at the nearby zoo is 
popular. It's sure to make you feel all 
warm and fuzzy.
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's check it out.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Ehehe, let's get lots and lots of 
healing together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We're here~! Let's see, the petting zoo 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Craft. Trainer too... Hehe, what a 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Cesario. Yeah, I just felt like 
petting some animals~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of varieties here, isn't 
there? To be honest, that's actually what 
I came for...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, is that so? ...Trainer. Since we're 
here, why don't we all look around 
together?
choice_data_list: Of course. Let's all have fun together.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, there are so many goats~. Hey, hey, 
let's try feeding them!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, dinner's ready. Eat plenty, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing. Everyone's gathering around 
Cesario...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush now. I'll share it with 
everyone... Make sure you chew well before 
swallowing, okay?

text_block_list.name: Goats
text_block_list.text: Baaaah...♪
choice_data_list: They've really taken a liking to you.
They've really taken a liking to you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If I do it like that, we can 
become friends...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's try copying Cesario too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Like me...? That's kind of embarrassing. 
But if you ever need help, feel free to 
ask me anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Come on over~, here's some super 
nutritious food~. Eat up and get all your 
energy back, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, they're not coming. I wonder what 
I did wrong.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush. Watch over them gently. If you 
do, they're sure to place their trust in 
you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Watch over them gently... I see. I'll give 
it a try.

Behind her, a single goat crept up. As if 
locking onto its target, it stared 
intently at the bag of feed—

text_block_list.name: Goat
text_block_list.text: "Baaah! Nom, nom, nom, nom!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa! My bait is...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! Geez, you scared me~. Were you 
really that hungry?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, I totally get it. After pushing 
myself super hard in training, I end up 
eating a ton too.

text_block_list.name: Goats
text_block_list.text: (Baaa, baaa)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*...! What's the matter? There's no 
food left, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, or maybe they're trying to cheer me 
up! Ehehe, everyone's so kind.
choice_data_list: I'll share my feed with you!
I'll share some of my feed with you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Then I'll just take half—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, they're gathering around again! 
Ahaha, so much fluffiness~.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It was so fun getting to interact with all 
the kids. I'd love to go see everyone 
again.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe we can get even closer next 
time! I'd love to relax together again~.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, I feel completely 
refreshed!
I feel so refreshed thanks to you!

Next time, let me show you my favorite 
spot.

Next time, I'd love to take you to one of 
my favorite spots.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe we can get even closer next 
time! I'd love to relax together again~.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, I feel completely 
refreshed!
I feel so refreshed thanks to you!

Next time, let me show you my favorite 
spot.

Next time, I'd love to take you to one of 
my favorite spots.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're exaggerating~. I was just 
having fun alongside everyone, really.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That's definitely very Craft-like... 
and I think that makes it special.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You really think so...? Then whenever 
you're tired, let's go out together again, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Your recommendation, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
You gave me so much energy, so consider 
this my thanks.

You gave me so much energy, so this is my 
way of thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... In that case, I'll take you up on 
that. I wonder where you're taking me~.
